The '''Battle of Fondor''' was a battle fought in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] during the [[Nagai–Tof War]]. A combined [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]/[[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] fleet repelled an attack on [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] by the [[Tof/Legends|Tofs]], with high casualties on both sides.<ref name="Forgotten War" />
